An analog water level / leak sensor (the S + - module and the like): Read gives how much of it is under water, Detect branches Wet or Dry, Water Trigger runs a branch when it gets wet (or dries off), and Calibrate measures its Dry and Wet levels.

actions.description: How much of the sensor is under water — level from 0 (dry) to 100 % (as deep as it goes), wet once it reaches Threshold, and the raw reading.

configurations.description: Board pin wired to the sensor's S — an analog input; GPIO32-39 keep working with Wi-Fi on.
Board pin wired to the sensor's + — powered only while it reads, so its traces don't corrode. Empty, wire + to 3.3 V.
The level it counts as wet from, in % — 1 to 100.
Readings averaged, 1 to 64 — more is steadier, a little slower.
The raw reading out of the water (0 %), 0 to 65535 — until Calibrate measures it on the sensor.
The raw reading as deep as it goes (100 %), 0 to 65535 — until Calibrate measures it on the sensor.

outputSchema.name: level
outputSchema.description: How much of it is under water, 0 (dry) to 100 %.

outputSchema.name: wet
outputSchema.description: Whether level reached Threshold.

outputSchema.name: raw
outputSchema.description: The voltage read, 0 (0 V) to 65535 (3.3 V) — to check the wiring and calibrate.

actions.description: Takes the reading now as the sensor's Dry level (out of the water) or Wet level (as deep as it goes), for Read, Detect and Water Trigger on the same Signal pin — run it once with each. Kept on the board (/data/water_sensor.json): it stays across runs and restarts.

configurations.description: Board pin wired to the sensor's S — an analog input; GPIO32-39 keep working with Wi-Fi on.

triggers.description: Runs its branch when the sensor gets wet — a leak, a tank full — or dries off, or either; read every Interval. Already wet when the program starts counts as getting wet.
